architecture.text: Behindthe ResponseSeeing a hand. Sensing a cup. Coordinating a physical response.From a gesture to movement.CameraHand-gesture inputMediaPipe + PythonRecognise the gestureBleak / BLESend the movement commandESP32Arduino C++ controls the driverMotor driver + motorsMove the companionThe cup sets the state.The load cell and HX711 amplifier send weight readings to the ESP32, which relays cup status to Python over BLE.Cup presentCUP_ONGesture control is enabled.Cup removedCUP_OFFGesture control is disabled. Python coordinates Unity’s drink animation until the cup returns.
